g.text: AR: no GDF gradient | AR_GDF: calibrated GDF | P frozen; full S trainable; BN running statistics fixed
Planned phase budget: 10,000 successful updates per arm | Only recorded observations are shown
TRAIN curves use exported raw samples; VAL points are original observations. Lines do not cross phase resets; future phases have no placeholders.
Patch Dice and field error do not substitute for final native VAL8. Total losses differ between arms; the primary segmentation term is shown separately.
